title: helictotrichon rigidulum
intro: Helictotrichon rigidulum, commonly known as Blue Oat Grass, is a type of ornamental grass native to the Iberian Peninsula. The plant is valued for its blue-green foliage, which is known to exhibit various health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Helictotrichon rigidulum are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help soothe skin irritations and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Blue Oat Grass include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
